description:
Run a named command that a native Android app registered with execbro-sdk-android (ExecBro.init { command("name") { ... } }).
PURPOSE: Drive app behaviour (lock, log out, reset state, seed data) through actions the app's developer exposed, without tapping through the UI. The native counterpart of calling a store action with execute_in_app.
WORKFLOW: list_debug_globals (lists commands) -> run_app_command({ name }) -> inspect_global to confirm the state changed. Call with no name to list the commands.
LIMITATIONS: Native Android apps with execbro-sdk-android only. Commands run on the app's main thread with a 5 s limit.
GOOD: run_app_command({ name: "lock" }); run_app_command({ name: "seed", args: { users: 3 } })
BAD: run_app_command on a React Native app: use execute_in_app there.

args.description: Arguments passed to the command as a JSON object.

device.description: RN device name (substring). Omit for default; see get_apps.

name.description: Command name. Omit to list the registered commands.

name: run_app_command
